facilities_sport_types_no_blanks.name: facilities_sport_types_no_blanks
facilities_sport_types_no_blanks.value: array_position("facilities"."sport_types", NULL) IS NULL AND array_position("facilities"."sport_types", '') IS NULL

facilities_geom_in_bulgaria.name: facilities_geom_in_bulgaria
facilities_geom_in_bulgaria.value: ST_X("facilities"."geom") BETWEEN 22.0 AND 29.0 AND ST_Y("facilities"."geom") BETWEEN 41.0 AND 44.5

facility_edits_has_value.name: facility_edits_has_value
facility_edits_has_value.value: "facility_edits"."old_value" IS NOT NULL OR "facility_edits"."new_value" IS NOT NULL

moderation_decisions_decision_matches_ta.name: moderation_decisions_decision_matches_target
moderation_decisions_decision_matches_ta.value:
("moderation_decisions"."target_type" = 'photo' AND "moderation_decisions"."decision" IN ('approved', 'rejected'))
          OR ("moderation_decisions"."target_type" = 'report' AND "moderation_decisions"."decision" IN ('reviewed', 'dismissed'))
          OR ("moderation_decisions"."target_type" = 'facility' AND "moderation_decisions"."decision" IN ('verified', 'gone'))

play_session_occurrences_cancel_fields.name: play_session_occurrences_cancel_fields
play_session_occurrences_cancel_fields.value:
("play_session_occurrences"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("play_session_occurrences"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("play_session_occurrences"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("play_session_occurrences"."cancellation_scope" IS NOT NULL)

play_sessions_rrule_count_xor_until.name: play_sessions_rrule_count_xor_until
play_sessions_rrule_count_xor_until.value: "play_sessions"."rrule" IS NULL OR NOT ("play_sessions"."rrule" LIKE '%COUNT=%' AND "play_sessions"."rrule" LIKE '%UNTIL=%')

play_sessions_rrule_byday_weekly_only.name: play_sessions_rrule_byday_weekly_only
play_sessions_rrule_byday_weekly_only.value: "play_sessions"."rrule" IS NULL OR "play_sessions"."rrule" NOT LIKE '%BYDAY=%' OR "play_sessions"."rrule" LIKE 'FREQ=WEEKLY%'

play_sessions_rrule_no_repeats.name: play_sessions_rrule_no_repeats
play_sessions_rrule_no_repeats.value:
"play_sessions"."rrule" IS NULL OR (
            (char_length("play_sessions"."rrule") - char_length(replace("play_sessions"."rrule", 'INTERVAL=', ''))) <= 9
        AND (char_length("play_sessions"."rrule") - char_length(replace("play_sessions"."rrule", 'BYDAY=', ''))) <= 6
        AND (char_length("play_sessions"."rrule") - char_length(replace("play_sessions"."rrule", 'WKST=', ''))) <= 5
        AND (char_length("play_sessions"."rrule") - char_length(replace("play_sessions"."rrule", 'COUNT=', ''))) <= 6
        AND (char_length("play_sessions"."rrule") - char_length(replace("play_sessions"."rrule", 'UNTIL=', ''))) <= 6)

account_deletions_counts_non_negative.name: account_deletions_counts_non_negative
account_deletions_counts_non_negative.value:
"account_deletions"."audit_rows_preserved" >= 0 AND "account_deletions"."photos_anonymized" >= 0
          AND "account_deletions"."condition_reports_anonymized" >= 0 AND "account_deletions"."points_erased" >= 0
          AND "account_deletions"."moderation_decisions_preserved" >= 0 AND "account_deletions"."sessions_cancelled" >= 0
          AND "account_deletions"."rsvps_erased" >= 0 AND "account_deletions"."checkins_erased" >= 0
